title: 三颗星，一扇门：把同一个游戏逐步做完整
Three stars, one door: complete one game step by step
intro: 这是本站编写的浏览器小游戏。收齐三颗星后走到 E，逐步查看核心循环、暂停、存档、触屏、适配与发布。代码验证只针对这个样例，不是引擎或 AI 产品评测。

This site-authored browser game asks you to collect three stars and reach E. Explore its loop, pause, saves, touch controls, resizing and publication. Code checks concern this example only, not engines or AI products.

title: 先让核心循环成立
Establish the core loop
change: 把关卡、玩家位置、已收集星星和步数分开保存。方向键或 WASD 改状态，再重画棋盘；碰墙不增加步数，出口在收齐星星后才算完成。
Keep level, position, collected stars and moves separate. Arrows/WASD update state before repainting. Walls do not add moves; reaching the exit completes the game only after collecting all stars.
check: 从起点向左撞墙，位置和步数都不变；走到星星只计一次。先到 E 但没收齐星星时不能完成。
Move left into a wall: position and moves stay unchanged. Count each star once. Reaching E before collecting all stars does not complete the game.
failure: 若出现走出棋盘、重复加星或碰墙加步数，先检查坐标、合法移动与状态更新顺序。不要从界面文字反推真实状态。
For out-of-bounds moves, duplicate stars or wall moves being counted, inspect coordinates, legal moves and update order. Do not treat UI text as the state store.

title: 暂停与重新开始
Pause and restart
change: 暂停是独立状态，不改关卡和收集进度。页面隐藏时自动暂停，回来后主动继续。重新开始只重置盘面，不删除已有浏览器存档。
Pause is independent of level/progress. A hidden page pauses; returning requires explicit resume. Restart resets the board without deleting a browser save.
check: 暂停后尝试移动，步数不变；继续后可走。切走再回来仍暂停。重新开始后位置回到起点、星星为零。
Moves stay unchanged while paused and work after resume. A hidden/returned page remains paused. Restart restores the initial position and zero stars.
failure: 若暂停时仍能走，检查所有输入入口是否经过同一状态判断。若重开误删存档，区分“重置当前盘面”和“删除此项目存档”。
If movement bypasses pause, route every input through one guard. If restart deletes saves, separate current-board reset from deleting this project’s saved data.

title: 版本化存档与失败降级
Versioned saves and fallback
change: 只保存关卡 ID、版本、坐标、步数和已收集项。读入时校验字段、位置和关卡，不信任文件中的完成标记。存储受限仍能玩，并可下载/读入 JSON 文件；不上传存档。

Save only level ID, schema version, coordinates, moves and collected items. Validate fields, position and level; derive completion rather than trusting a flag. Storage-blocked play still works with JSON download/import. Saves are not uploaded.
check: 走几步保存，刷新后点载入，位置与星星恢复。导出文件再读入也应一致。错误版本、墙内坐标、重复星星或过大的文件应拒绝，当前盘面不变。

Save after moving, reload the page and load to restore position/stars. Export/import should agree. Reject wrong versions, wall positions, duplicate stars and oversized files while preserving the board.
failure: localStorage 受站点与浏览器策略影响，file:// 的行为不能保证。打不开存档先保留原文件，不清空整个浏览器存储；本例只接受版本 1，不假装完成迁移。

localStorage depends on origin and browser policy; file:// behavior is not guaranteed. Retain an unreadable file rather than clearing all browser storage. This example accepts version 1 only and does not pretend to migrate it.

title: 让触屏与键盘走同一条逻辑
Share movement between touch and keyboard
change: 四个方向按钮调用相同的 move 函数，不另写一套触屏规则。按钮保留可点尺寸与键盘焦点；只在棋盘聚焦时接管方向键，不阻止整页滚动与缩放。
Directional buttons call the same move function as keyboard input. Keep usable targets/focus. Capture arrows only while the board has focus; do not block page scrolling or zooming.
check: 用屏幕按钮和方向键走相同路线，结果一致。暂停时两种入口都不移动；Tab 能进出棋盘和按钮，不形成焦点困住。
The same route through buttons/arrows yields the same state. Both honor pause. Tab enters/exits the board and controls without a focus trap.
failure: 若触屏能穿墙或暂停不生效，查是否绕开了共用 move。若页面无法缩放，检查是否误用全页 touch-action:none 或无条件阻止事件。
For touch-only wall/pause bypasses, inspect the shared move path. For lost zooming, check whole-page touch-action:none or unconditional event prevention.

title: 改变显示尺寸，保留游戏状态
Resize the view without resetting state
change: 棋盘用七列弹性网格，尺寸由容器控制；坐标存在状态里，不以屏幕像素存档。窄棋盘选项只是显示练习，所有阶段都保留基础窄屏可读性。
Use seven flexible columns within the container. Store coordinates in state, not screen pixels. The narrow-board option is a display exercise; every stage retains basic narrow-screen usability.
check: 走几步后切换窄棋盘、调整窗口或横竖屏，位置、星星、步数不变。检查 320 像素宽度、长英文文本和控件，不只看页面有没有横向滚动条。
After moving, switch board width or resize/orient the window without losing position, stars or moves. Check 320px widths, long English text and controls, not only the presence of a scrollbar.
failure: 若缩放后回起点，检查布局事件里是否重置了状态；若存档落错格，检查是否把像素坐标当格子坐标。
If resize restarts play, inspect state resets in layout handlers. If loads shift cells, distinguish pixel and grid coordinates.

title: 打包、回放与发布检查
Package, replay and check publication
change: 下载包包含 HTML、脚本、样式、品牌资源、素材记录和哈希清单。游戏本身没有网络请求或后端；站群与文档链接另需联网。发布自己的作品时检查代码/素材许可、资源路径、大小写、HTTPS 和目标浏览器。

The download includes HTML, scripts, styles, brand assets, an asset ledger and hashes. The game itself has no network calls/backend; site/document links need connectivity. For your own publication, check code/asset rights, paths/case, HTTPS and target browsers.
check: 对解压后的文件实际玩一局，再验证暂停、读写存档、存储受限、键盘与触屏。核对台账和每个发布文件；一次页面可打开不等于全部检查通过。
Play the extracted package, then check pause, saves, blocked storage, keyboard and touch. Inspect the ledger and every published file; one successful page load is not a complete release check.
failure: 路径错误先查大小写与相对路径；刷新后丢存档先查来源/协议与浏览器策略。样例下载不另行授予再分发许可，发布复制内容前先按本站条款核对。

For missing files, check case and relative paths. For lost saves, check origin/protocol and browser policy. The sample download grants no separate redistribution licence; check site terms before republishing copied content.
